text:
violet: Morning! ALERT: someone absconded with the office snickerdoodle platter between 8:30-9:00. crumbs leading to the bench? :cookie:

ash: oh no. I saw crumbs near the slack couch but assumed it was a toddler.

fred: guilty-ish 10% guilty. I helped myself to one and left a sad paper napkin. not the whole platter though.

violet: it was the whole platter. gone. there is a single cinnamon dust trail and a Post-it that says "maybe".

kitchen-bot: security note: shared food etiquette reminder: label communal platters with name/date and "SHARED". Weekly fridge sweep: Monday 4pm. Inventory link: https://redwood.internal/kitchen-inventory

nora: tiny idea: two-tier approach 1) communal jar (clearly labelled) 2) personal boxed items. Also can we stop the mug shuffle? my travel mug keeps wandering.

kevin: +1 on mug protocol. I propose a simple sticker template: initials + team. quick print command for Brother QL:

```
ql2200 --text "K: Kevin (Infra)" --qty 1
```
Leave by the mug shelf.

ash: vote: sticker + mug shelf vs designated mug locker (tiny cubby). react with :bookmark_tabs: for sticker shelf, :lock: for cubby.

fred: :bookmark_tabs: stickers are easier. cubby sounds like extra furniture.

nora: :lock: cubby prevents mixups during meetings when people borrow mugs and forget.

violet: also small PSA: if you take someone else's mug, please rinse. we are not a science lab.

facilities: we can add a 6-cubby shelf for mugs and a magnetic sticker sheet. ETA 4 business days. budget approved.

kitchen-bot: inventory update: coffee beans low, sugar packets low, napkins low. Automated reorder can be enabled for staples.

kevin: on the snickerdoodle mystery: I can bake a replacement batch tomorrow morning if we want to keep the peace. gluten-free option too.

nora: unanimous yes. also can we add a small sign near the pastry area: "COMMUNAL = SHARE, PERSONAL = DO NOT EAT"? so many ambiguous leftovers.

ash: I'll create a quick template sticker and pin it to the printer. tiny label: "COMMUNAL - please enjoy! (date)".

violet: outcomes: facilities orders mug cubby + sticker sheet, kevin bakes replacement snickerdoodles tomorrow (GF option), sticker template added, auto-reorder suggested for coffee beans. Case closed 1unless the cinnamon trail resurfaces. :mag:
